items.title: Lloyds partners with Superscript for digital SME insurance platform
items.summary: Lloyds Banking Group has integrated SME insurance onto a self-serve digital platform operated by broker Superscript across its UK business banking base.

items.title: Prime Minister Andy Burnham considers national insurance cuts for youth jobs
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said he will examine proposals from a report by Alan Milburn to reduce national insurance contributions for younger workers.

items.title: Small brokers in line for £2,000 youth hiring premium under Milburn review
items.summary: Insurance brokers with fewer than 50 staff could receive an extra £2,000 for hiring long-term unemployed young people under Alan Milburn's final report on youth unemployment.

items.title: Industry appointments span Gallagher Bassett, Duck Creek and USQRisk
items.summary: Recent insurance industry personnel changes include new executive roles at Gallagher Bassett, Charles Taylor Assistance, Duck Creek, USQRisk, The Fidelis Partnership and Brokerslink.

items.title: Aurora secures US backing to scale algorithmic underwriting beyond QBE
items.summary: Managing general agent Aurora has secured investment from IA Capital Group to expand its algorithmic underwriting platform across the specialty insurance market following its live test case with QBE.

items.title: Core Specialty reports revenue drop and lower net income in US IPO filing
items.summary: US property and casualty insurer Core Specialty Insurance Holdings has filed for an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange.
